g.title: CN10
g.text: Polarization comes from the header, not this housing - check whether CN10 is shrouded. If it is a bare pin header, mark pin 1 and continuity-check before the first plug-in. Pins 1, 5, 6 unpopulated.

g.title: DIVIDER
g.text: Board end. R3 series on TX. R1/R2 divider on RX. Values in the BOM below.

g.title: J4
g.text: GaggiMate Pro Rev 1.1 UART port. +5V left unconnected.
